description: A young dragon whelp with a molten glow emanating from its scales. The Smolderfang Hatchling is known for its volatile temperament and fiery breath. Although small, it is incredibly fast and packs a deadly bite that sears with burning embers.

traits.name: Molten Scales
traits.description: The Smolderfang Hatchling's scales radiate intense heat. Any creature that hits the hatchling with a melee attack takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

traits.name: Fiery Breath (Recharge 5-6)
traits.description: The hatchling exhales a 15-foot cone of fire. Each creature in the area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.
